rows.source_review: Hadoop 3.4.3 TestDFSRollback.testRollback deliberately exercises valid and invalid rollback states. DataStorage.doRollback:939-941 compares prior storage layout version and cTime against current software and NameNode namespace. Actor V2 binds the preceding RPC to the startup episode, actual DataNode/storage volume and raw NN0 endpoint. All 123 selected postfault InconsistentFSStateException events match the guard/actor/volume signatures seen in both healthy JUnits; they are expected rollback rejections, not new bugs. One selected fault plan lost the target and was excluded from the effective denominator. The mechanical 80-to-128 extension was triggered by one global BlockManagerSafeMode.reportStatus status-logging branch unrelated to this target; the final eight effective runs added no new production coverage or stable I/O family. See independent raw/source review.
